stateMachine.entryCondition: init() checks localStorage cmaMaySelectedLearnerId. If exists -> skip handshake. If not -> enter greeting flow.

greetingMessage: Welcome back — have we met before?
yesPath: Presents 8 synthetic student names as clickable rows. Each row shows display name + session count + truncated profile summary.
noPath: Calls askForName() — existing flow. On name set, marks profile synthetic/preProduction, persists selectedLearnerId, enters READY_TO_TUTOR.
selectedStudentSummary: After selection: displayName, profileSummary, readinessSnapshot, weakAreas, progressSignals, session count, pre-production disclaimer.

uiRendering.ASK_RETURNING: Chat area shows greeting + two buttons: 'Yes — I've been here before' / 'No — I'm new here'
uiRendering.SHOW_STUDENT_ROLL: Chat area shows list of 8 clickable student rows
uiRendering.CREATE_NEW_STUDENT: Chat area shows name prompt (existing askForName flow)

safetyMarkers.preProductionWarning: ⚠ This is a pre-production pilot environment. Your data is synthetic and stored locally only.
